cells.old: Compute, do NOT let the portal compute. (a) Determine the BASE under CST art. 253: the LAST monthly salary if it has not varied in the last three months; otherwise, and for every variable salary, the AVERAGE of the last year of service, or of the whole period served if shorter. (b) ADD THE TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE where it is payable - CST art. 253 requires it and it is payable where the salary does not exceed 2 SMMLV (COP 3,501,810 in 2026). (c) Multiply by days of service over 360. (d) Round to the whole peso - not up to the next 100 as PILA requires, and not to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires. (e) Validate against the floor of one day of one SMMLV (COP 58,363.50 for 2026). (f) Where a lawful partial settlement was made during the year under CST art. 254, deduct it. Write the result into positions 128-136, right-aligned and zero-filled, with '0000' in positions 124-127.

cells.old: CST art. 253 requires the transport allowance in the base. Following the portal short-deposits COP 249,095 for this employee, and a short deposit is penalised as non-deposit at one day's salary per day of delay, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's figure into T14.
cells.new: The transport allowance is part of the cesantias base: Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7 treats the transport allowance as salary for the sole purpose of liquidating prestaciones sociales. Following the portal short-deposits COP 249,095 for this employee, and a short deposit is penalised as non-deposit at one day's salary per day of delay, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's figure into T14.
